theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : n ^ 2 ≥ 2 * n + 3 := by
  have h1 : n - 3 ≥ 0 := by rw [hn]; exact zero_le_sub_right
  have h2 : n + 1 ≥ 0 := by simp
  have h3 : (n - 3) * (n + 1) ≥ 0 := mul_nonneg h1 h2
  rw [mul_left_distrib] at h3
  rw [sub_add, add_sub] at h3
  exact h3
